title: Unpooling operators skip input checks on MPS
body:
This code feeds completely invalid inputs to `max_unpool3d`. On CPU it fails saying "elements in indices should be type int64 but got: Float", but on MPS it returns an empty tensor. I also see it with `max_unpool2d`:
```python
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

x = torch.rand((2, 3, 4), dtype=torch.float32, device="mps")
indices = torch.rand((2, 3, 4), dtype=torch.float32, device="mps")

y = F.max_unpool3d(
    x,
    indices,
    kernel_size=(1, 2, 3),
    stride=(1, 2, 3),
    padding=(1, 2, 3),
)
print(y)
```
